products.name: GP-Trich
products.informacion: Biological fungicide formulated with strains of Trichoderma harzianum and Trichoderma viride, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ conidia/g or mL. Its antagonistic action helps protect the crop against phytopathogenic fungi while promoting colonization of the root zone, root development and better uptake of water and nutrients.
products.funcion: Helps prevent and control diseases caused by phytopathogenic fungi, such as wilt and root rot associated with Fusarium spp., Phytophthora spp., Rhizoctonia spp. and Pythium spp., among others. It also strengthens the root system and supports the balance of the soil microbiota.

products.name: GP-Trichobac
products.informacion: Broad-spectrum biofungicide combining 50% Trichoderma harzianum (1×10⁹ conidia/g) + 50% Bacillus subtilis (1×10⁹ CFU/g). Its dual action brings together antimicrobial, mycoparasitic and defense-inducing mechanisms, providing protection on roots, stems, leaves, flowers and fruit.
products.funcion: Supports the integrated management of diseases affecting roots and foliage, such as root rot, blight, powdery mildew, moniliasis, rust and wilt. The combined action of Trichoderma + Bacillus subtilis broadens protection against phytopathogens such as Fusarium spp., Rhizoctonia spp., Pythium spp., Phytophthora spp., Botrytis spp., Moniliophthora roreri and Hemileia vastatrix.

products.name: GP-Subtix
products.informacion: Biofungicide formulated with Bacillus subtilis at a concentration of 1×10⁹ CFU/g. This beneficial bacterium is used in the biological control of phytopathogenic microorganisms, favors beneficial microorganisms in the rhizosphere and activates the plant's natural defense mechanisms.
products.funcion: Helps prevent and reduce diseases caused by phytopathogenic fungi on roots and foliage, especially those associated with Fusarium spp., Pythium spp., Rhizoctonia spp., Botrytis spp., Phytophthora spp. and Alternaria spp. It also favors the beneficial microbiota of the rhizosphere and activates the plant's natural defenses.

products.name: GP-Bauver
products.informacion: Biological insecticide formulated with Beauveria bassiana, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ conidia/g or mL. This entomopathogenic fungus is specialized in pests that mainly attack leaves, shoots and fruit and is integrated into biological management programs to reduce insect pressure.
products.funcion: Biological control of thrips, whitefly, aphids, mealybug, mites, weevils, fall armyworm, leafhoppers and other susceptible insects that damage the aerial part of the crop.

products.name: GP-Meta
products.informacion: Biological insecticide formulated with Metarhizium anisopliae, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ conidia/g or mL. It is especially useful against insects that develop or remain in the soil and acts on larvae, pupae and adults present in the substrate, helping to reduce their populations.
products.funcion: Biological control of white grubs, Andean weevil, corn rootworm, fall armyworm, weevils, aphids, whitefly and other susceptible pests, with particular usefulness in managing soil-associated insects.

products.name: GP-Thuring
products.informacion: Biological insecticide formulated with Bacillus thuringiensis var. kurstaki at a concentration of 1×10⁹ CFU/g. It produces toxins active against insects during their larval stage and is aimed mainly at managing defoliating larvae that consume leaves and shoots.
products.funcion: Biological control of loopers, borers, bagworms, fall armyworm, cabbage moth and other susceptible larvae that cause perforations, defoliation and damage to shoots.

products.name: GP-Warduo
products.informacion: Broad-spectrum biological insecticide combining 50% Beauveria bassiana + 50% Metarhizium anisopliae, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ conidia/g or mL. The complementary action of both fungi makes it possible to work on pests present both in the aerial part and in the soil.
products.funcion: Biological control of thrips, aphids, whitefly, weevils, fall armyworm, mites, mealybug and other susceptible pests. It is aimed at situations that require broader management of insects in different areas of the crop.

products.name: GP-Lilax
products.informacion: Biological nematicide formulated with Purpureocillium lilacinum, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ conidia/g or mL. It is specialized in managing plant-parasitic nematodes that affect the root system, helping to protect the roots, preserve their function and support better crop development.
products.funcion: Helps regulate populations of Meloidogyne spp., Pratylenchus spp., Rotylenchulus reniformis and Radopholus similis, among other plant-parasitic nematodes responsible for root damage and reduced growth.

products.name: GP-Bio
products.informacion: Liquid agricultural biostimulant made from fish hydrolysate, with 25% free amino acids, plus nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, micronutrients and peptides.
products.funcion: Stimulates plant growth and development, strengthens roots, improves nutrient uptake, helps reduce stress and activates natural defenses.

products.name: GP-Megafort
products.informacion: Multifunctional biofertilizer composed of 30% Bacillus megaterium + 30% Azotobacter vinelandii + 40% Bacillus subtilis, at a concentration of 1×10⁹ CFU/g. The consortium favors phosphorus solubilization, biological nitrogen fixation, root development and better nutrient availability.
products.funcion: Strengthens fertility and the root system, improves crop vigor and contributes to protection against soil pathogens such as Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, Pythium and Phytophthora.

products.name: GP-Clean
products.informacion: Agricultural potassium soap made with fatty acids from fish oil, with 35% potassium salts.
products.funcion: Physical control of soft-bodied pests such as aphids, whitefly, thrips, scale insects and mites. It also cleans sooty mold, honeydew, dust and surface fungi from leaves.

products.name: GP-Oil
products.informacion: Natural agricultural oil based on fish oil emulsified at 25%, rich in essential fatty acids.
products.funcion: Improves the adhesion, coverage and persistence of biological products and plant extracts; it also exerts a physical action on pests and helps protect the plant.

history.title: Our History
history.text: Greenprod Sustainable was born with the conviction that productivity and caring for the environment can go hand in hand. We are a company focused on driving agricultural and marine productivity through innovative practices, producing organic fertilizers and generating value in seafood products to improve the quality of life of local communities.

missionVision.title: Mission and Vision
missionVision.missionText: To drive agricultural and marine productivity through innovative and environmentally friendly practices, producing organic fertilizers and seafood products that improve the quality of life of local communities.
missionVision.visionText: To be a leading company in the production of agricultural bio-inputs and sustainable seafood products, recognized for our innovation, environmental commitment, and contribution to responsible agriculture and fishing that promote healthy ecosystems.

missionVision.title: Who We Are
missionVision.subtitle: We are a Peruvian company of innovation and sustainable production that transforms marine waste into solutions for a more efficient and responsible agriculture. We produce bio-inputs and biofertilizers, integrating biotechnology, engineering and the circular economy, in order to care for crop health organically while reducing environmental impact.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: GreenProd transforms by-products from Chimbote's artisanal fishing into high-performance organic bio-inputs, through biotechnology and a circular model that benefits fishers and farmers alike. We operate in Áncash, with plans to expand to other agricultural regions of the country.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be a leading company in the production of agricultural bio-inputs and sustainable seafood products, recognized for our innovation, environmental commitment, and contribution to responsible agriculture and fishing that improve the quality of life of local communities and promote healthy ecosystems.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Green Prod & Sustainable S.A.C., located at Av. Uno Mz. 1 Lote 1, Bloque "E", AA.HH. Tres Estrellas, Nuevo Chimbote, Áncash, is responsible for the personal data collected on this site. This policy explains what data we ask for, what we use it for and how you can control it, under Peru's Personal Data Protection Law 29733 and its regulations.
Privacy.reviewNotice: Document pending legal review. The company tax ID (RUC) and the personal data bank registration number with the National Authority for Personal Data Protection still need to be filled in.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Only what you give us in a form: to place an order we ask for your name or company name, DNI or RUC, email, phone and delivery address; through the contact form, your name, company, email and message; to subscribe to news, only your email. We do not collect sensitive data and we do not buy third-party lists.

sections.heading: What we use it for
sections.body: Order details are used to fulfil the order, arrange payment and delivery and issue the receipt. Contact form details are used to reply to you. The subscription email is used only to send you news, launches and promotions, and nothing else.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use necessary cookies, which keep your cart and language and without which the site does not work, and measurement cookies, which are only enabled if you accept them and tell us in aggregate, anonymous form how many people visit and which pages they see. You can refuse the measurement ones without losing any feature. Cookies only reach this site: they give no access to your email, your social accounts or your activity on other pages.

sections.heading: Marketing emails
sections.body: Accepting cookies does not subscribe you to anything. You will only receive emails if you enter your address in the subscription form and tick the consent box. Every email carries an unsubscribe link, and you can also ask to be removed by writing to us.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: We do not sell or transfer personal data. We share it only with those needed to fulfil your order: the carrier that delivers the product and, once online payment is enabled, the gateway that processes the charge. Your card details never pass through this site: they are entered directly in the gateway form.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Order data is kept for as long as the commercial relationship lasts and for the period required by tax regulations. The subscription email is kept until you ask to be removed.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can request access to your data, its correction, its deletion, or object to our use of it, by writing to gerencia@greenprod.pe. We reply within the deadlines set by law. If you believe your request was not handled, you may complain to the National Authority for Personal Data Protection of the Ministry of Justice.

Privacy.contactBody: For any question about this policy or your data: gerencia@greenprod.pe · +51 919 514 085
